scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix simulator ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.dev: docker compose --env-file .env.development -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up -d --build db api simulator web
scripts.prod: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f compose.yml -f compose.prod.yml up -d --build db api simulator web
